digest.component_or_area: test suite: plan review manifest tests
propositions: Manifest byte-equality tests flake under pytest-xdist when concurrent workers touch the git checkout, causing git dirty-state to flip between separate build_manifest calls
manifest.py stamps provenance via _signing.gate_code_version() which shells git status --porcelain on each call, creating a race window for dirty-state changes
Two test sites (test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes and test_manifest_is_deterministic_and_path_independent) compare separately-built manifests without pinning the git version
Monkeypatching rebar.signing.gate_code_version to a constant in affected tests eliminates the race and prevents -dirty suffix flapping between calls
test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes already uses the monkeypatch pattern successfully
